title: Quick Spaghetti with Garlic Tomato Sauce and Basil
summary: A fast Italian-style pasta dinner with a bright, garlicky tomato sauce and fresh basil. It is simple, comforting and ideal for a busy weeknight.
steps: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Add the spaghetti and cook until al dente according to the packet instructions, usually 9–11 minutes. Reserve 100 ml of the pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the sliced garlic and cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant and just pale golden, taking care not to burn it.

Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds, then add the canned tomatoes, dried oregano, chilli flakes, salt and black pepper. Crush the tomatoes with a spoon and simmer for 10–12 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and tastes rich.
Add the drained spaghetti to the sauce with a splash of reserved pasta water. Toss for 1–2 minutes until the pasta is glossy and well coated, adding a little more pasta water if needed.
Turn off the heat and stir through most of the torn basil. Serve immediately with the remaining basil scattered on top.
